name: Rim-light sweep reveal

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-3, 2026-11-26): a dark teaser reveals a large letter mark only through glints travelling along its edges.

technique: In darkness, a thin highlight travels along the edges of a large shape, so its silhouette is read from the rim light before the shape is ever fully lit. The viewer assembles the shape from glints, which builds suspense.
purpose: Build suspense by letting the viewer assemble a shape from glints before it is lit.
visual_behaviour: In near darkness a thin warm highlight travels along the edges of a large shape, a second glint starts on another edge, and only then does the whole shape fade up.
mechanics: Dark shape a few percent brighter than the background; a narrow gradient (accent to transparent) masked to the shape's edge stroke travels along it at about 300-500 px/s with a soft glow, 2.0-2.6 s for a frame-filling shape (ref-99713f6e72 0-2.6 s, 10 fps strip); a second glint starts on another edge at about 1.4 s; the full shape fades up only after the sweep (2.4-2.7 s).

decomposition.timing: Sweep 2-2.6 s; reveal fade about 0.3 s.

parameters.name: sweep_duration
parameters.description: Seconds for the highlight to travel

use_cases: A teaser or reveal of a symbol
A mysterious opening on a dark section
Introducing a shape before naming it
failure_modes: On a light canvas it disappears; dark sections only
A fast sweep loses the suspense

implementation.approach: The dark shape a few percent brighter than the background; a short gradient dash (accent to transparent) on the shape's edge path, moved by stroke-dashoffset at about 300-500 px/s with a soft glow filter, 2.0-2.6 s for a frame-filling shape; a second dash starts at about 1.4 s; fade the full shape up over about 0.3 s after the sweep. Approximates rim light: real surface falloff needs a Blender plate.

capability.approximation: A travelling gradient stroke with glow reproduces the glint; the falloff of light across a real surface is lost.
capability.advanced_path: A Blender plate (visual-director) with a moving rim light when the shape must read as a lit 3D object.

provenance.observed: An ember-orange highlight travels along the edges of a large dark letter mark (0-2.6 s); a second glint starts on another edge at about 1.4 s; the mark reads only from these glints until 2.6 s.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
